title: D = 90 mm, L = 1 m copper cylinder with axial coaxial probe: TM01p f, Q, C (BI-RME paper Table I, CST)

citations.authors_short: P. Navarro, B. Gimeno, et al. (BI-RME 3D modal analysis of axion-photon coupling in microwave resonators)
citations.journal: journal NOT verified (earlier 'J. Comput. Phys. (2022)' unsupported; possibly Phys. Dark Univ.); cite as arXiv:2107.03137

citations.authors_short: Y. Kim, D. Kim, J. Jeong, J. Kim, Y.C. Shin, Y.K. Semertzidis
citations.journal: Phys. Dark Univ. 26 (2019) 100362, 'Effective approximation of electromagnetism for axion haloscope searches'
items_used: upstream source of the benchmark cavity ('Figure 4 of [16]', 2107.03137 Sec. 4.2.1 p.17) and of g a0 = -8.51e-22
citations.note: . Its own f/Q/C values were NOT checked here (PDF not retrieved); TODO before using this benchmark beyond TM010.

software.code: CST Studio Suite (eigenmode/driven) + MATLAB post-processing; BI-RME 3D
software.solver_type: eigenmode values tabulated (CST), wide-band BI-RME response in figures

geometry.description: closed copper cylinder; 50-ohm coaxial probe inserted at the centre of the top cap, designed for critical coupling of TM010

conventions.form_factor_definition: Eq. (23): C_m = |int_V E_m . B_e dV|^2 / int_V ||B_e||^2 dV with E_m normalized (int |E_m|^2 dV = 1 implied by the BI-RME basis); equivalent to the standard C = |int E.z|^2/(V int |E|^2)
conventions.notes: Table I modes are those coupled to the axial probe

tables.description: TM01p modes of the probed cylinder

analytic_check.method: closed form for the EMPTY cylinder (no probe), PEC frequencies, perturbative wall Q with sigma = 6e7: Q = (R/delta)/(1+R/L) for p=0, (R/delta)/(1+2R/L) for p>=1; C = 4/x01^2 for p=0, 0 otherwise

gaps.proposal: benchmark the EMPTY cylinder against the closed form; treat Table I as a probe-perturbed reference: model the probe as a flush (zero-depth) coax aperture first, then sweep depth 0-10 mm and report which depth reproduces f1 = 2.55920 GHz
use sigma = 6e7 S/m, classical skin effect

inconsistencies.description: All six TM01p frequencies are uniformly +0.33..+0.37% above the R = 45 mm closed form (TM010 2.5592 vs 2.5501 GHz). A uniform offset points to a radius offset (R = 44.835 mm fits all rows), not to the probe (an axial pin in the high-E region would LOWER TM010 and affect modes differently).
inconsistencies.evidence: Table I vs f = c sqrt((x01/R)^2 + (p pi/L)^2)/(2 pi)
inconsistencies.proposal: benchmark f at the 0.5% level, or run R = 44.835 mm as the 'as-simulated' radius; record the discrepancy

inconsistencies.description: Q_m increases with p in Table I (33069 -> 33782), whereas the closed form predicts Q(TM011) ~4% BELOW Q(TM010) (end-cap losses double for p>=1)
inconsistencies.evidence: Table I Q column vs closed form (analytic_check)
inconsistencies.proposal: use only Q(TM010) as a benchmark (1.2% below closed form, plausibly probe loss / mesh); report TM01p Q discrepancies

inconsistencies.description: C for TM01p (p>=1) is exactly 0 for an ideal cylinder in uniform axial B; Table I gives 5.2e-3 ... 7e-6 (probe-induced asymmetry and numerical noise)
inconsistencies.proposal: benchmark only C(TM010) = 0.68505 vs 0.69166 (-0.96%); p>=1 values are noise-level

inconsistencies.description: TM01p frequency spacing implies an effective length 1.001-1.029 m (not 1 m) relative to the table's own TM010
inconsistencies.proposal: consistent with a probe perturbation of mainly TM010/TM011; no action

solver_class.reason: cylinder + centred axial coax probe is fully axisymmetric (TM0np); the 2D solver needs a coax port/PEC pin for the probed case

priority_reason: empty case is closed form; probed case is a 2D-axisym test of a centred pin

readme_row.quantities: f, Q, C of TM010-TM015 (probed cylinder)
